research_question: On a project-fresh frozen set, does V54's selective per-target discourse state machine distinguish executable requests, descriptions, cancellation, hypothetical language, quoted data, metalinguistic non-requests, and explicit action prohibition better than the same fresh V51 local-model control without creating a false action?
project_effect: This tests one bounded cognitive function needed before VRM integration: deciding whether a grounded action reference is a current executable request. It does not modify memory, personality, right-brain wording, the active chat runtime, or physical actuation.
evidence_boundary: The 64 cases and every gate were frozen before inference. Thirty-two cases preserve exact Tatoeba Japanese text and attribution; thirty-two are manually authored controlled cases. Exact project-input and V52 source-ID overlap are forbidden. Project freshness does not prove exclusion from the base model's pretraining data.
model_usage_policy: Call the fixed local V51 model exactly once per grounded target to create the matched control and frozen fallback. V54 adds no second model call. Smaller or larger models are not compared unless the preregistered abstention trigger fires after this run.

target_mention_patterns.expression.neutral: (?:ニュートラル|いつも通り|いつもの|無表情|普通|標準|真顔|元)
target_mention_patterns.gaze.user: (?:会話相手|こちら|こっち|正面|カメラ|目線|私|俺|僕|目)
target_mention_patterns.motion.idle: (?:そのままの姿勢|動かない|動かず|じっと|アイドル|待機)

model_escalation_rule.next_experiment: Compare free local model sizes only on the frozen unresolved subset with identical prompts, carrier, seed policy, and token budget. Prefer the smallest model that meets selective-risk gates; intelligence and parameter count are not goals by themselves.

failure_routing.representation: If construction or mention representation fails, repair candidate grounding and freeze a new dataset before inference.
failure_routing.resolved_state: If high-confidence deterministic transitions are wrong, reject V54 and redesign the discourse-state representation rather than patching item text.
failure_routing.fallback_model: If unresolved fallback accuracy triggers the model rule, compare free local model sizes on only that frozen subset.
failure_routing.compiler: If commitments are correct but calls are wrong, keep V54 frozen and repair the action compiler in a separate matched experiment.
failure_routing.ambiguous_data: If independent human review finds a gold label genuinely ambiguous, retire the item and report it; do not score it opportunistically.

decision_rule.advance: Only if construction, state, matched, and end-to-end gates all pass. A pass authorizes design of no-actuation shadow integration, not runtime or physical execution.
decision_rule.state_pass_compiler_fail: Freeze V54 state semantics and preregister a compiler-only repair; do not change V54 or claim end-to-end readiness.
decision_rule.fallback_trigger: Run a separate local model-size experiment only when both fallback-count and fallback-accuracy thresholds fire.
decision_rule.state_failure: Reject V54 generalization and use failure attribution for a structural successor; no post-hoc sentence patching on this holdout.
